newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's McConnell launches Vietnam container service.
newsitem.headline: NZ's McConnell launches Vietnam container service.

text.p: McConnell International Ltd, one of the biggest New Zealand investors in Vietnam, said on Tuesday it was launching a door-to-door container service.
The service would be based on Vietnam Railways and an inland continer terminal near Hanoi.
McConnell said it was the first foreign firm to be given a license to be a transport manager and freight forwarder in Vietnam.
The company had entered a joint venture with Vietnam Railways -- their first joint venture -- to provide an international standard container service in the "booming Vietnam economy", McConnell said.
McConnell has been asked to discuss proposals to extend the service from the Chinese border to Ho Chi Minh City.
